verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Capacities serves a valid llms.txt at docs.capacities.io/llms.txt (HTTP 200) with a structured description of its documentation, which an agent could point to directly, and the docs site is also structured with per-page raw markdown files suited for agent consumption. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that an agent successfully uses this llms.txt to navigate docs, and no explicit vendor messaging framing this as an agent-oriented feature.
